title: Time Jump: 14:40 to 15:00 MDT, Coyote Draw Fire at 800 Acres

fields.narration: TIME JUMP. EXERCISE, EXERCISE, EXERCISE. Exercise elapsed time is 2:00. The clock moves forward 20 minutes to 15:00 MDT, still Wednesday 14 April 2027. At 14:55, Battalion 1 estimated the Coyote Draw Fire at about 800 acres with 0 percent containment. That is almost double the 420 acres reported at 14:30. Spot fires have crossed CR 68 in zone CR-07. The head is running east-southeast toward Gulch Village, zone PG-03, and Kestrel Springs sits behind it. Gulch Saddle station reads west-northwest 31 mph, gusting to 52 mph, with relative humidity at 8 percent. The strike team and the air tankers ordered through Northern Colorado are not on scene. Traffic on Kestrel Springs Road and eastbound on CR 68 is heavy and slow. Cell tower PG-14 has been on battery for 7 hours, and the carrier's last estimate was 8 hours. The zone board shows only the statuses the EOC has set in the last hour. Any zone you have not set has no status. You are now working the 15:00 situation.
worldState: 15:00 MDT, Wednesday 14 April 2027. Coyote Draw Fire: about 800 acres (Battalion 1 field estimate, 14:55), 0 percent containment. The last mapped figure was 420 acres at 14:30.

Spot fires have crossed CR 68 in zone CR-07. The head is running east-southeast toward Gulch Village (PG-03). Kestrel Springs (KS zones, including KS-04 with Stonebridge) is behind Gulch Village on the same line of travel.
Weather at Gulch Saddle station: WNW 31 mph, gusts to 52 mph, RH 8 percent. The Red Flag Warning remains in effect until 20:00 MDT.

The 14:30 projection from Battalion 1 (PG-03 arrival 16:15 to 17:00, latest order time about 15:20, EOC target 14:50) was based on a 420-acre fire. The 14:50 target has passed, and no updated projection has been given.
The strike team and the air tankers are ordered but not on scene. There is no estimated arrival time yet.
Circuits 6, 7, 11 and 12 have been de-energized for 7 hours, since 08:00. Restoration requires a full circuit patrol and 2 hours of gusts under 35 mph. Neither condition is met.
Cell tower PG-14 has been on battery for 7 hours. The carrier's last estimate was 8 hours, so it has about 1 hour left, until roughly 16:00. Cell coverage in Pine Gulch is at risk after that.
Pine Gulch Elementary: 31 of 140 students are still in the gym waiting for parent pickup. One school bus is still on Gulch Road (CR 68).
Stonebridge Assisted Living: 18 ambulatory residents have moved out by van, and 22 are still on site. Those 22 include the 12 non-ambulatory residents, 4 of whom use oxygen concentrators.
Traffic is heavy and slow on Kestrel Springs Road and on CR 68 eastbound. Highway 305 canyon status has not been updated since the morning.
Kestrel Springs pump station is still on generator. High Plains Fuel still cannot reach it before 18:00.
The fourth most-critical medical baseline household on Gulch Road is still unconfirmed.
Zone board: only the statuses the EOC set in the last hour are shown. Any zone not set has no status.
fields.facilitatorNote: Pause for 1 minute after reading so each role can update the shared board before any new inject. If asked, Battalion 1's updated projection puts the PG-03 arrival at about 15:50 to 16:30. That makes the latest order time for PG-03 (55-minute clearance) about 14:55 to 15:35. KS-04 has a 120-minute clearance with 22 residents still on site, so its order is effectively late already, and shelter-in-place at Stonebridge (EOP 5) is a live option if the order slips.
fields.scenarioTitle: One Road Out: PSPS, Evacuation Timing & Shared Zone Status

instructorNote: This card resets the room to 15:00 MDT, after the 14:50 order target has passed. Watch for: EM recalculating the latest order times for PG-03, KS-04 and the CR zones under EOP 4 and making the order decision before them; SHF confirming which egress routes are open before any order is issued; FC giving an updated arrival projection; and DISP confirming that WEA and SawmillAlert are ready before PG-14's battery runs out at about 16:00.
